prompt:
Do most of pipeline's sink threads stay idle while one or a few do all the work? If so, which sinks are idle?

Begin your answer with exactly one line: "Verdict: yes", "Verdict: no", or "Verdict: cannot tell from this trace". Then answer the question.
answer:
Verdict: no

Across the whole trace (0–30,622 ms), the four sink threads did comparable amounts of work: sink-0 ran 22.7% of its time, sink-1 22.7%, sink-2 23.0%, and sink-3 21.1%. None was idle; their CPU times were similar, about 6,340–6,895 ms each.

They were blocked for roughly 76–78% of the time, but the trace attributes those waits to waiting for work from the parser (TID 642977), not to sinks sitting idle while one sink did the work. The parser itself mostly waited on the reader (TID 642978); the analysis rates its hold-up as minor. The watchdog (TID 642972) was idle, but it is not a sink.
